directional_acceptance.target: Actor records Yes to the introduction by assigned_day + 7
directional_acceptance.no_response: Recorded event did not occur; not a preference rejection
directional_acceptance.censoring: Exclude pairs without both observed response events

mutual_acceptance.target: Both directions record Yes by assigned_day + 7
mutual_acceptance.dependence: Joint model fitted directly, not a product of directional predictions

date_given_mutual.target: A date happens no later than assigned_day + 30
date_given_mutual.conditioning: Both recorded Yes to the introduction by deadline
date_given_mutual.censoring: Exclude missing date events rather than fabricating an outcome

timely_seconds_given_date.target: Both members record second-meeting Yes within three days of the date
timely_seconds_given_date.conditioning: A completed date happened within thirty days of assignment
timely_seconds_given_date.no_response: Absence of a timely recorded Yes; not a dislike label
timely_seconds_given_date.censoring: Exclude pairs without both observed second-meeting events

training_observations: Capture public directed and symmetric features before assigning each introduction
conditional_chain: Mutual acceptance times timely date given mutual times timely mutual second intention given timely date
